description: Own LinkedDevice diagnostics collector and optional adapter diagnostic sink. Reuse Amarula.Telemetry events; extend existing adapter listener callback boundary for receipt/message observation only, preserve original forwarding/results/attempt fences. Tests first for optional callback failures, stale attempts, decrypt/retry counters, offline/group flags, server acceptance vs recipient receipt and unknown status rejection. No new Action: internal observation is not a composable domain operation. Local adapter source override and exported patch required until upstream published. Document missing per-message correlation in existing retry/decrypt telemetry; no inference of retry causality. Verify adapter tests and ZAQ observer tests.
